visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young male chef with short dark hair, wearing a crisp white professional chef's coat, stands in the center of a brightly lit kitchen studio. He speaks enthusiastically with a wide smile, gesturing with his hands to emphasize his words. The background features a soft yellow wall decorated with playful illustrations of Winnie the Pooh and honey pots. In the foreground, several yellow and white cookware pieces from the MEYER collection are neatly arranged on a counter. Large yellow and white text overlays appear at the top and bottom, including a "2 days" countdown. (2) The camera maintains a medium shot of the chef, who continues to address the audience with high energy and expressive facial movements. As he speaks about benefits, animated graphic bubbles displaying icons for a "free spoon" and "free shipping" pop up on the screen beside him. The lighting remains bright and even, highlighting the glossy finish of the yellow pots and the chef's professional attire. The Winnie the Pooh graphics in the background create a warm, nostalgic, and friendly atmosphere. (3) The chef points directly towards the camera in a final call-to-action gesture, his expression inviting and energetic. New text overlays in bold yellow and black colors fill the bottom half of the frame, urging viewers to place their orders immediately. The cookware remains visible at the bottom of the screen, serving as a constant visual anchor for the product being promoted. The overall visual arrangement is dense with promotional graphics, designed to capture attention quickly in a social media format.

A short, high-frequency "whoosh" sound effect accompanies the first text transition, adding a sense of movement. The speaker's delivery is clear and well-enunciated, showing high emotional arousal and a positive valence. (2) The speaker continues his pitch with increased intensity and excitement, listing the promotional offers such as free shipping and gift spoons. A distinct "pop" or "bubble" sound effect is heard as each new gift icon is visually introduced, synchronized perfectly with the rhythmic pulse of the BGM. The music maintains its energetic flow without pausing, providing a consistent acoustic floor. The speaker's voice remains dominant in the mix, with the music tucked neatly underneath at a balanced volume level, ensuring every word is clearly audible. (3) The audio reaches its climax as the speaker delivers a final, urgent call to action: "Hai bu gan kuai xia dan!" (Hurry and order now!). The vocal tone is authoritative yet friendly, with rising intonation that builds excitement. A sharp "stinger" or rhythmic accent in the music marks the end of the promotional sequence, followed by a quick fade-out. The acoustic environment is very clean, resembling a professional studio recording with no significant ambient noise or technical distortion.
